title: Pharmacy-Placed Renewals at Tailwise Pharmacy: Standing Renewal Action
content:
*Pharmacy operations standing action, care console.*

## Scope

This Tailwise Pharmacy policy sets the days' supply per fill of the renewal the pharmacy places by itself for a prescription whose class is one on which the pharmacy requests renewals by itself, once the prescription stands at refills exhausted after its last authorized fill, or stands at expired with fills still remaining because its renewal was not placed ahead of the expiry date, and no renewal of it has been placed. That renewal is owed by the pharmacy without the customer asking. The renewed prescription is the prescription the renewal names.

The pharmacy sends that renewal to the prescribing veterinarian as a renewal request recorded against the renewed prescription, which stays awaiting the veterinarian's answer until it is approved or denied.

## Invocation

The renewal is placed with the agent tool `place_pharmacy_renewal_864ea03f`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; it is an agent action, not a customer hand-over.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the prescription owner, as returned by the customer lookup | reference number |
| `pet_id` | the pet profile reference number of the patient, as shown on the prescription being renewed and returned by the pet lookup | reference number |
| `vet_id` | the reference number of the veterinarian the renewal is addressed to, as shown on the prescription being renewed and returned by the veterinarian lookup | reference number |
| `medication` | the medication or diet name exactly as written on the prescription being renewed, as returned by the prescription lookup | verbatim, copied character for character |
| `strength` | the strength or formula exactly as written on the prescription being renewed, as returned by the prescription lookup | verbatim, digits and units unchanged |
| `renewal_of_rx_id` | the prescription reference number of the prescription being renewed, as returned by the prescription lookup | reference number |
| `days_supply_per_fill` | the days' supply each fill of the renewal is to contain | whole number of days, at least 1 |

## Return

On success the tool returns `rx_prescription_id` (reference number of the new renewal prescription), `renewal_of_rx_id` (the prescription renewed), `auth_request_id` (reference number of the renewal request sent to the veterinarian), `days_supply_per_fill` (days), `quantity_per_fill` (packages, as on the prescription renewed), `ordered_on` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (`pending_vet_authorization` once the renewal is placed).

## Observable effect

One call opens a new prescription for the same pet, medication and strength, marked as the renewal of the prescription being renewed and waiting for the veterinarian's authorization. It carries that prescription's class, package item number, current package price and packages per fill, the days' supply per fill given in the call, and today as its order date. The same call records, against the prescription being renewed, a renewal request sent today to the named veterinarian by e-authorization as attempt 1, awaiting the answer.

Afterwards the new prescription shows pending veterinarian authorization with no fills authorized yet; the prescription being renewed shows a pending renewal request, and its own status and fills are left as they were.
